annotation.bound_parties_text: The advisory circular provides guidance to operators of RPAs (and Remote Pilots, designers/developers of RPA systems) and to NCAA staff processing operators certificates and approvals.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Advisory Circular (AC) has been developed to provide guidance to operators of RPAs in the operation of RPAs and the means whereby they may safely and legally operate RPA systems.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This AC is the first to be published on this subject in Nigeria and is subject to review as the need arises.
